articles.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
articles.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack in the Tatarstan region, one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

articles.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
articles.description: One person has died in the Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia which has spread over 53 sq miles.

articles.title: British couple jailed in Iran end hunger strike after several months, family says
articles.description: A British couple jailed in Iran over alleged spying have ended a three-month-long hunger strike against their sentence, their son has said.

articles.title: FIFA attacks critics trying to 'undermine' Gianni Infantino
articles.description: FIFA has accused critics of a "concerted and ongoing effort" to undermine its president Gianni Infantino, amid claims that UEFA paid off an alleged mistress while he led European football's governing
